description: This Java class 'ChangesModel' manages configuration commands related to file and network modifications, including add, remove, move, optimize, copy, and merge network requests. It reads commands from a file or list, parses them, and stores them in appropriate data structures.

classes.name: ChangesModel
classes.description: Singleton class that manages a collection of change requests such as add, remove, move, optimize, copy, and network merge requests. It provides methods to read configuration commands from a file or list and to clear stored requests.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ChangesModel.

methods.name: readConfiguration
methods.description: Reads configuration commands from a specified file, parsing and storing the requests.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Parses a list of command lines, identifying and storing different types of change requests.

methods.name: addMoveRequest
methods.description: Parses and adds a move request to the list.

methods.name: addAddRequest
methods.description: Parses and adds an add request to the list.
